description: This Java test source file contains JUnit tests for the RabbitMQPublisherActor, which is part of a messaging system implementing RabbitMQ messaging within a specific project. It tests multiple acknowledgment handling, message publishing, and confirming mechanisms for the publisher actor.

classes.name: RabbitMQPublisherActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of RabbitMQPublisherActor, including message acknowledgements, publishing, and confirmation handling using mocks and Akka test probes.

methods.name: testMultipleAcknowledgements
methods.description: Tests the publisher actor's handling of multiple acknowledgments, including positive and negative ACKs, and the aggregation of acknowledgments into a response.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up the test probe and mocks necessary for the tests.

methods.name: publisherCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of the publisher actor, simulating channel creation.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides the Props object for creating the RabbitMQ publisher actor.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgments are correctly received and processed.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Checks that a message was published with correct headers and properties.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies message publication to a reply target with correct headers.

methods.name: setUpPublishConfirmMode
methods.description: Prepares the mocked AMQP channel to simulate publisher confirm mode and capture the confirm listener.
